subject: How Rippling is building a "GTM Super App" with AI (and what we learned!)
body:
Hey First Name,

Our latest 🦄 ai that works session dove into "GTM Engineering and AI at Rippling: Building the GTM Super App"! It was a really interesting look at how they're bringing software engineering principles and AI to go-to-market operations.

Good news! You can now find the full recording, code, and diagrams from the session on GitHub:
https://github.com/hellovai/ai-that-works

We packed a lot into the session, exploring how Rippling is actually using software engineering and AI to transform their go-to-market. Here’s a quick rundown of what we covered:

- **Moving Past Basic Reports:** We talked about how Rippling is shifting from static BI reports to smart AI agents. These agents don't just show you data; they can actually "talk" with it and help you take action, making analytics much more proactive and woven into daily work.
- **Rippling's AI Evolution:** We got a peek into Rippling's real-world experience with AI. They started with agents using fixed SQL tools and are now moving towards agents that can write their own SQL queries on the fly. We also looked at how they're solving common issues like slow queries with tools like SQL Glot, and how they bring human insight into data aggregation.
- **The "GTM Super App" Dream:** Picture this: a "GTM Super App" where AI agents handle the nitty-gritty of coding, system maintenance, and digging through complex data. This frees up GTM teams to really focus on the big picture and strategic initiatives.

If there's one key takeaway from the session, it's this:
By applying an engineering mindset and leveraging AI agents, GTM operations can become a truly integrated "Super App." This isn't just about speed; it's about making smarter decisions faster, automating the tedious data work, and ultimately letting go-to-market teams spend their time on what truly moves the needle.

Got questions? Just hit reply or hop into our Discord: https://www.boundaryml.com/discord. We genuinely read every message! Happy coding 🧑‍💻

Vaibhav & Dex
